content.json:
## SailPoint ISC Operations

Operator view over SailPoint Identity Security Cloud telemetry in this Sentinel workspace. Use the time range below; account-activity and workflow panels stay empty until those pollers ingest rows.

content.title: Volume and failures

content.query:
SailPointISC_Events_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Outcome = toupper(coalesce(Status, ""))
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Failures = countif(Outcome in ("FAILED","FAILURE","ERROR"))
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Events vs failures (hourly)

content.query:
SailPointISC_Events_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(ActorName)
| summarize EventCount=count(), Failures=countif(toupper(Status) in ("FAILED","FAILURE","ERROR")) by ActorName
| top 15 by EventCount desc
content.title: Top actors

content.query:
SailPointISC_Events_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(TargetName)
| summarize EventCount=count(), Failures=countif(toupper(Status) in ("FAILED","FAILURE","ERROR")) by TargetName
| top 15 by EventCount desc
content.title: Top targets

content.query:
SailPointISC_AccountActivities_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count=count() by Status=coalesce(Status, "(none)"), Stage=coalesce(Stage, "(none)")
| order by Count desc
content.title: Account activity status / stage
content.noDataMessage: No account activities ingested yet (poller may be quiet or still within the 15-minute delay).

content.query:
SailPointISC_Events_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(TrackingNumber) or toupper(EventType) == "ACCESS_REQUEST"
| summarize Count=count() by Status=coalesce(Status, "(none)"), EventType=coalesce(EventType, "(none)")
| order by Count desc
content.title: Access-request related events

content.query:
SailPointISC_WorkflowHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Outcome = toupper(coalesce(Status, ""))
| where Outcome in ("FAILED","FAILURE","ERROR")
    or WorkflowName has_any ("Response","Remediation","Disable","Contain","Intel Response","SecOps")
| project TimeGenerated, WorkflowName, Status, HistoryType, OwnerName, WorkflowExecutionId, RequestId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent failed / remediation workflows

content.query:
SailPointISC_Events_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend
    Outcome = toupper(coalesce(Status, "")),
    Category = toupper(coalesce(EventType, "")),
    TechName = toupper(coalesce(TechnicalName, "")),
    ActionName = toupper(coalesce(Action, ""))
| where Outcome in ("FAILED","FAILURE","ERROR")
    or Category in ("USER_MANAGEMENT","AUTH","ACCESS_REQUEST","SOURCE_MANAGEMENT","SYSTEM_CONFIG")
    or TechName has_any ("ADMIN","PASSWORD","DISABLE","ENABLE","DELETE")
| project TimeGenerated, ActorName, TargetName, EventType, Action, TechnicalName, Status, AttributesUserId, TrackingNumber
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Security-relevant ISC events

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
  (SailPointISC_Events_CL | extend TableName="SailPointISC_Events_CL"),
  (SailPointISC_AccountActivities_CL | extend TableName="SailPointISC_AccountActivities_CL"),
  (SailPointISC_WorkflowHistory_CL | extend TableName="SailPointISC_WorkflowHistory_CL")
| summarize
    RowCount = count(),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    AgeMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), max(TimeGenerated))
  by TableName
| extend Health = case(
    RowCount == 0, "Empty",
    AgeMinutes > 180, "Stale",
    "OK")
content.title: Table freshness

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where DataType startswith "SailPointISC_"
| summarize IngestedMB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), DataType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Ingested MB (7d)
